label: Inverted Center Pleats
description: Inverted center pleats are folds turned inward toward the centerline so the pleat's depth is hidden beneath a smooth surface at the center back. This yields a clean exterior appearance while still releasing extra fabric for movement underneath. The effect is a tidy, refined back that combines comfort with a more polished, concealed pleat.
